definition: The x component of the direction of the placement's local x axis.  Together with ref_direction_y and ref_direction_z this is the "ref_direction" attribute of a STEP axis2_placement_3d, which is a direction; the three components are its direction_ratios and need not be normalized.  The local y axis is implied, being the cross product of the local z and x axes.
name: ref_direction_x
